# GSAP (vendored)

Core + ScrollTrigger + SplitText from [gsap](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap) v3.13.0,
used under GreenSock's Standard "no charge" license: https://gsap.com/standard-license.

Vendored locally (instead of a CDN) so the portfolio has no third-party runtime
dependency. To update, fetch the package and copy the three `dist/*.min.js` files here.
